Params: {1: '1', 2: 'Teddy', 3: "We're clear. Those rioting machines didn't follow us down.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Moore', 3: 'Thanks for the backup. I thought I was finished back there.', 4: '2'}
{3: 'Deeper in the sewers, the three slow their pace, finally clear of the rioting machines and now heading for the exit.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Moineau', 3: 'Why were you operating alone? Did you request backup from HQ?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Moore', 3: "Old White retired the day before yesterday. They haven't assigned me a new partner yet.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Moore', 3: 'Really? I always thought you kept up with all the office gossip.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Moore', 3: "My comms got jammed during the fight. Couldn't call for help.", 4: '2'}
{3: 'Moore probes the wound at his waist, and a sharp hiss of pain escapes his clenched teeth.'}
{2: 'Moore', 3: 'How did you two end up down here?', 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Teddy', 3: "We're investigating a homicide on Arclight Avenue. The victim had a storage unit at the docks. We found a hidden passage there leading to these sewers.", 4: '18'}
{2: 'Moore', 3: 'They just dug a private tunnel from their unit into the city sewers?', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Moineau', 3: 'No, she was probably a data analyst. Population statistics, census work, that sort of thing.', 4: '1'}
{3: "Moore misses Moineau's dry humor entirely. Teddy shoots her a sharp look, but Moineau only answers with a nonchalant shrug."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Teddy', 3: 'She was likely... some kind of hacker.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'No official records, and she was using stolen bank accounts.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Moore', 3: "Interesting. Seems like everyone's a hacker these days.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Moore', 3: "Yeah. I'm on a missing persons case, but we can't find any record of the person who filed the report.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Moore', 3: "Disguised voice, unknown gender and age. Couldn't even trace the IP.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Moore', 3: "To bypass our security like that... we're definitely dealing with a professional.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The trio follows the sewage as it converges through a labyrinth of pipes, finally spewing out to sea through a massive drainage outlet.'}
{3: 'Just beyond, blinding searchlights sweep the area. Public Safety anti-grav cars hang in the night sky, their red and blue lights flashing a stark warning.'}
{1: '1', 3: "Moore perches on the edge of an anti-grav car's trunk as a medic tends to his wounds. The radio channel crackles nonstop with a stream of incoming reports."}
{3: 'He pivots to face the other two and makes a suggestion.'}
{2: 'Moore', 3: 'Mind bringing me up to speed on your case?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Moore', 3: 'Both our investigations led to the sewers. There has to be a connection.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'A silent, knowing look passes between Teddy and Moineau.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Moineau', 3: "Apartment 703, 442 Arclight Avenue. The victim's name is Christina...", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Moore stares at Teddy, his expression one of genuine surprise.'}
